lead.name: Verity Bakehouse
lead.address: 42 Wellington St E, Aurora, ON L4G 1H4, Canada

copy.hero_sub: A small bakehouse on Wellington Street, open six days a week.
about: We bake sourdough, pastry and a short list of cakes in the room behind the counter. The dough for the morning is mixed the evening before and left cold overnight.
There is no menu that runs all year. What is on the shelf is what came out of the oven this morning, and when it is gone it is gone.
copy.services_intro: What tends to be on the counter, most days.

services.name: Country sourdough
services.description: A long-fermented white loaf, baked dark.

services.name: Butter croissants
services.description: Laminated in the shop, baked twice a morning.

services.name: Morning buns and danishes
services.description: Whatever fruit is worth using that week.

services.name: Cakes to order
services.description: Round cakes for a birthday or a Sunday, ordered ahead.

services.name: Coffee
services.description: Filter and espresso, to sit in or take out.
